finding: PRINTED: "Create an X/X blue and red Weird creature token, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard. Then you may return an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand. Exile Experimental Overload." ENGINE(observed): uncastable — the compiled tree turns "Exile Experimental Overload" (exile self) into a TARGET/BATTLEFIELD/IS_SOURCE selector that must be designated pre-resolution; the battlefield population is empty at designation, so the cast raises "executor: cast: illegal target selection: selection:count_below_min:0<1". Token and recursion never happen. Loud.
